title: Bootstrap admin example password is below the 8-character minimum
problem: .env.example sets ADMIN_PASSWORD to a 5-character placeholder. ensureBootstrapAdmin silently returns when password length is under 8, so a copied example never creates the first staff user.
impact: Fresh environments that copy the example cannot bootstrap staff login.
fix_plan: Replace the example with an 8+ character placeholder and document the length rule. Do not print or commit real values.
resolution: Example password is now an 8+ character placeholder. Length rule documented in ENV.md.

title: Guest checkout can reuse any unowned address ID
problem: assertAddressAccess allows any guest to attach an address whose userId is null, including orphans created in another guest checkout.
impact: A guest who obtains another guest address UUID can reuse it. IDs are UUIDs so guessing is hard; still a trust-boundary gap.
fix_plan: For guests, only allow address IDs already attached to the current checkout session. New addresses stay on the inline-create path.
resolution: Guests may only reuse address IDs already on the current checkout session.

title: Admin middleware checks cookie presence only
problem: Expired or forged-looking eckam_staff_session cookies still render the admin shell. API still returns 401.
impact: Confused UX, not a data bypass. API RBAC remains authoritative.
fix_plan: Keep API as authority. Document as defense-in-depth limitation unless a cheap session check can be added without new deps.
resolution: Middleware moved to apps/admin/src/middleware.ts so the src-dir app can apply it. Cookie presence is still the only UI check. Live redirect after process restart not re-measured.
verified_by: admin production build lists Proxy (Middleware); live 307 [NOT VERIFIED]

title: Auth rate-limit IP taken from untrusted forwarded headers
problem: Client IP is read from X-Forwarded-For / X-Real-IP without a trusted-proxy gate.
impact: A directly exposed API process can have per-IP limits spoofed.
fix_plan: Limitation unless production sits behind a trusted proxy. Do not invent a proxy config.
resolution: Do not invent a trusted-proxy config. Document for production deployment behind a known proxy.

title: Auth and cart rate limits are in-process only
problem: Auth/cart limiter is memory-backed; multi-instance deployments do not share buckets.
impact: Limits reset on restart and do not span instances.
fix_plan: Limitation until REDIS_URL is intentionally enabled. Do not add Redis now.
resolution: Requires a shared store decision. AI limits already use PostgreSQL.

title: Unbacked shipping and checkout promises in chrome
problem: Header, hero, and mobile drawer claim complimentary express shipping, India and international delivery, and secure checkout. No shipping or payment provider is configured.
impact: Customers are promised delivery and payment capabilities that are not operational.
fix_plan: Replace with editorial brand lines that make no shipping, delivery-time, or payment promises.
resolution: Announcement, hero, mobile drawer, and checkout header no longer promise shipping or secure checkout.
verified_by: browser snapshot of home; HTML shippingClaim=false

title: Best Sellers section implies sales ranking from placeholders
problem: Heading and copy say Best Sellers and customers return to pieces, while the default list is a local placeholder array with no sales data.
fix_plan: Relabel to an editorial heading and feed live catalogue cards when the API returns products.
resolution: Heading is Selected Pieces. Live catalogue cards shown when API returns products.

title: Homepage placeholder cards link to catalogue slugs that may not exist
problem: New Arrivals, Best Sellers, and related-product helpers link to static slugs. PDP is API-only and renders not-found when the slug is unpublished.
evidence: Home now shows live priced products; placeholders href /shop
impact: Primary homepage merchandising can send shoppers to empty product pages.
fix_plan: Load homepage rails from GET /v1/catalogue/products. Point leftover placeholders at /shop. Use API related products. Call notFound() for unknown slugs.
resolution: Homepage uses loadHomeCatalogue(). Related products from API. Placeholders link to /shop.

title: EST. 2026 and Real stories headings overclaim
problem: Header shows EST. 2026. Customer Stories heading says Real stories while all cards are forthcoming. Root keywords include haute horlogerie, which is not a shop category.
fix_plan: Neutralize EST line, stories heading, and unused category keywords.
resolution: EST line replaced; stories heading is Stories ahead; unused keywords removed from root metadata.

title: Currency selector is display-only but labeled Delivery and Currency
problem: Header currency dropdown only updates local React state. It does not change catalogue currency or shipping.
impact: Shoppers may believe prices or delivery country changed.
fix_plan: Relabel as a display preview and state that catalogue prices are unchanged.
resolution: Interactive currency/country picker removed. Header shows Prices in INR.

title: Expected /login and /signup aliases are missing
problem: Auth lives at /account/login and /account/signup. Expected launch routes /login and /signup have no pages.
fix_plan: Add redirect pages that preserve a safe next param.
resolution: /login and /signup redirect to /account/* and keep a safe next param.

title: Account gate drops return-to path
impact: Deep-linked account pages lose the destination after sign-in.
fix_plan: Pass the current pathname through safeReturnTo.
resolution: AccountGate passes usePathname() into login/signup next.

title: Missing sitemap, robots, metadataBase, and admin noindex
problem: No sitemap.ts, robots.ts, metadataBase, Open Graph, or Twitter metadata. Admin layout is indexable by default. Favicon.ico is referenced but absent.
impact: Weak indexing control; admin may be indexed; broken icon.
fix_plan: Add env-driven metadataBase, sitemap of indexable routes only, robots disallow for account/cart/checkout, admin noindex, and a branded SVG icon.
resolution: sitemap.xml 200, robots.txt 200, admin robots noindex, icon.svg added.

title: No root error or not-found App Router files
problem: Neither web nor admin defines error.tsx or not-found.tsx. Unknown product slugs render an in-page component instead of notFound().
impact: Generic Next fallback; invalid slugs may not send 404.
fix_plan: Add branded not-found and error pages; call notFound() on unknown product slugs.
resolution: Root error/not-found files exist and page calls notFound(). Dev HTTP status for unknown slug remained 200 with not-found UI.
verified_by: HTTP 200 + product not found body for /shop/this-slug-does-not-exist-qa

title: Payment provider is intentionally unconfigured
problem: No live payment adapter is registered. Checkout must stay honest.
impact: Orders cannot be paid until a provider is chosen by the business.
fix_plan: Do not add a provider. Verify the unconfigured path stays honest.
resolution: Business must select and configure a payment provider. Test adapter must stay disabled in production.

title: AI provider is unconfigured in production
problem: Production AI mutations fail closed without AI_PROVIDER/key. App must start without a key.
impact: Assistant is unavailable until a key is supplied.
fix_plan: Do not add a real key. Verify unconfigured responses are safe.
resolution: Optional provider. Startup must not require AI_API_KEY.

title: Legal pages are informational drafts; contact and newsletter do not deliver
problem: Privacy, terms, and refund policy are labeled drafts. Contact and newsletter disclose that no provider delivers messages.
impact: Cannot claim production-legal completeness or inbound email.
fix_plan: Keep draft labels. Do not invent legal text or contact details.
resolution: Needs counsel-approved copy and a real email/contact provider.

title: Parallel typecheck/lint OOM on this machine
problem: pnpm typecheck and pnpm lint run together aborted with JavaScript heap out of memory (exit 134).
evidence: C:\Users\WeShippX\AppData\Local\Temp\eckam-baseline-typecheck.txt FATAL ERROR heap out of memory; same for lint
impact: Workspace gate must be run sequentially with a larger heap to get a real PASS/FAIL.
fix_plan: Re-run with workspace-concurrency=1 and NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096. Record true results.
resolution: Sequential typecheck/lint pass. Parallel workspace scripts still OOM on this machine.
